name: Barclays CashForward® World Mastercard®

apr.notes: Variable APR based on creditworthiness. No annual fee. 0% introductory APR on balance transfers.

base_rate.description: Earn 1.5% cash back on all purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn 5% bonus on all rewards redeemed into a Barclays account. Redeem cash back as statement credits, deposits into a Barclays account, or gift cards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $100 cash back after spending $500 on purchases in the first 90 days.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: Free Online FICO Credit Score Access
benefits.description: Free online access to your FICO Credit Score.

benefits.title: 5% Redemption Bonus
benefits.description: Get a 5% bonus on all rewards redeemed into a Barclays account.

notes: Discontinued November 2017. 1.5% cashback with 5% redemption bonus when redeeming into a Barclays account. No annual fee, 3% foreign transaction fee. Verified from Wayback Machine snapshot of the official Barclays product page (Feb 2017).
